scope: Machine-readable generated projections and cross-artifact agreement guard

Updated specs/cross-artifact-agreement-registry.json to require generated projections carrying retired-substrate text to expose that boundary and point current interim authority to ADR-0516.
Updated scripts/ci/assert-cross-artifact-agreement.rs so //:cross-artifact-agreement-check mechanically verifies the boundary tokens in both generated projection files.
Did not rewrite ADR-derived deliverable descriptions, post statuses, mutate GitHub branch protection, mutate Kubernetes/cloud resources, or claim native CI authority.
